description: This Java source file defines a Freemarker template transform class 'CsrfTokenPairNonAjaxTransform' used to inject CSRF tokens into non-Ajax HTTP responses within the OFBiz framework. It specifically overrides the getWriter method to produce a Writer that appends the CSRF token to the output stream after processing the template variable 'request'.

classes.name: CsrfTokenPairNonAjaxTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker TemplateTransformModel that generates and appends a CSRF token in non-Ajax calls for security purposes.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a custom Writer that captures template output and appends a CSRF token obtained from the request, as part of rendering process.
